'''The Sarlacc Pit''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] that participated in the [[Feast of Prosperity/Legends|Feast of Prosperity]] in [[3626 BBY]].<ref name="Reveal" /> The cantina was named after the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and their natural habitats.<ref name="Sarlacc">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' novelization]]</ref> It was staffed by various [[Service droid/Legends|service droids]] that could be controlled remotely, as well as a difficult-to-please<ref name="Reveal" /> [[J4-SN Chef Droid|J4-SN]]<ref name="Onslaught" /> [[Head Chef Droid]] who consistently stressed out the cantina's proprietor.<ref name="Reveal" />
